name: sabre-band
about: The Korean War F-86 identification band: a yellow band bordered by a thin dark-blue line on each side (the 4th FIW style, with the port's blue lining). Made for sides: around — the band is 1.0 wide along the picture's X (size = the band's width along the fuselage) and 200 tall in Y so it wraps the whole body. '@' = the placement's colour, yellow by default.
